categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Menon Animal Nutrition Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the research, development, production, and sales of feed additives and enzymatically hydrolyzed protein feed raw materials. Its product portfolio includes functional feed additives, nutritional feed additives, enzymatic protein feed raw materials, and concentrated feed, serving various animal species such as pigs, ruminants, poultry, and aquatic animals.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages core technologies including formulation technology, preparation technology, and bio-enzymatic hydrolysis technology to enhance nutrient absorption and utilization in animals. It employs advanced manufacturing processes such as controlled-release coating technology for nutritional additives and enzymatic hydrolysis for plant protein feed raw materials. The company also integrates digital and intelligent manufacturing systems to optimize production efficiency and quality control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include large and medium-sized feed and livestock enterprises across China, such as Haida Group, New Hope, Tongwei, Tiankang Bio, Hefeng, Lihua, Boen Group, Muyuan, COFCO, and others. The company serves the feed processing and animal husbandry industries domestically and exports to over 40 countries and regions across Asia, Europe, Africa, North and South America, and Oceania.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Shanghai, Suzhou, Chengdu, and LeLing. Internationally, it has established sales networks in more than 40 countries including Vietnam, Russia, Thailand, the Philippines, Japan, South Korea, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Egypt, Jordan, Turkey, Brazil, Spain, and Mexico, focusing on Belt and Road countries and expanding into Europe and the Americas.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanghai Menon operates mainly in the midstream segment of the animal nutrition supply chain, focusing on the development and production of feed additives and protein feed raw materials that are supplied to feed manufacturers and livestock producers downstream.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes a 'species-specific, product-specific, full-process nutrition' product strategy, focusing on innovation in feed additives and enzymatic protein feed raw materials. It invests heavily in R&D, collaborating with universities and research institutes to develop new products such as rumen-protected amino acids, acidifiers, plant essential oils, and enzymatic corn protein. Digital transformation and intelligent manufacturing are also strategic priorities to enhance operational efficiency and product quality.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of feed additives and enzymatic protein feed raw materials. The company uses a direct sales model for large domestic clients and a distributor model for smaller domestic and international customers. Revenue is recognized upon transfer of control of goods, typically at delivery or export clearance.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Shanghai Menon is a leading player in China's feed additive and enzymatic protein feed raw material industries, with over 27 years of experience. It holds a strong domestic market position and is expanding its international footprint. The company is recognized for its technological innovation, product quality, and comprehensive service offerings, distinguishing itself from competitors through its integrated product and solution approach.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 490 million, a slight decrease of 2.87% year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 49.6 million, down 21.35%. Despite revenue contraction, operating cash flow improved by 11.87%. The company maintains a solid asset base of around RMB 790 million and continues to invest in growth projects such as a 100,000-ton enzymatic corn protein processing facility. International business revenue grew by 25.24%, indicating strong growth potential.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shanghai Menon emphasizes delivering 'efficient, green, and safe' animal nutrition products that enhance feed nutritional value, improve animal health and production performance, reduce feed costs, and promote environmental sustainability. Its product differentiation lies in advanced formulation and enzymatic hydrolysis technologies, comprehensive species- and stage-specific nutrition solutions, and strong technical service capabilities that create value for customers and partners.
